senses.gloss:
चैतन्य चैतन्य, i. e. चेतन + य, n.
 1. Intellect. Yājñ. 3, 81.
 2. Consciousness, [] Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 18.
 3. Soul, spirit, MBh. 14, 529.
चैत्त चैत्त, i. e. चित्त + अ, adj. Belonging to the dominion of thought, Vedāntas. in Chr. 209, 22.

चैत्य चैत्य,
 I. probably चिति + य, m. The individual soul, Bhāg. P. 3, 26, 61.
 II. चिता + य, m. and n.
 1. A tomb, MBh. 12, 914.
 2. An altar, Rām. 1, 13, 30.
 3. A religious building, Rām. 5, 17, 20.
 4. A sacred tree; a religious fig-tree growing in a village, or near it, and held in veneration by the villagers, Hiḍ. 1, 40.
 --Comp.

चैत्र चैत्र, i. e. चित्र and चित्रा + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Made of a tree called citra, MBh. 7, 76.
 II. m. The name of a month, March--April, Man. 7, 182.
 III. f. त्री, The day of the full-moon in this month, MBh. 12, 3691.

चैत्ररथ चैत्ररथ, i. e. चित्र-रथ + अ,
 I. adj. Treating of the Gandharva Citraratha, MBh. 1, 313.
 II. patron. m. and f. थी, A descendant of Citraratha, MBh. 1, 3740; Hariv. 712.
 III. n. The name of a forest, Rām. 1, 28, 37.
चैत्य- + पाल चैत्य- + पाल, m. the watchman of a sanctuary.
चैत्य- + वृक्ष चैत्य- + वृक्ष, m. a fig-tree growing in a holy place, Man. 9, 264.
